title: TimeSeries BIDS converted
description: A functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) time-series dataset converted to BIDS format from a MATLAB file containing hemoglobin concentration time series (HbO) from 18 subjects across two sessions, with ICA-based denoising applied. The dataset is a BIDS conversion of an original deposit and includes NIRS recordings and associated metadata.
methods_description: Data were converted from a MATLAB .mat file (TimeSeriesHbORT_18sub_twoSessionICAdenoise) to BIDS using the convert_mat_to_bids.py script. The README notes that sampling frequency, channel count, and source/detector mapping in the *_nirs.json files should be reviewed.
